title: Ex 5.2 · If n² is odd, n is odd
prompt: Use contrapositive proof. Let $n$ be an integer. Show that if $n^2$ is odd, then $n$ is odd. Write the proof of the contrapositive with the steps below.
answer_format: A structured proof: let, case, expr and witness steps (notes optional). No final answer box.
hints: Negate both parts and swap them: if n is even, then n² is even.
Assume n is even, write it as 2·(integer), and show n² is even.
solution: Contrapositive: if $n$ is even, then $n^2$ is even.
So the original statement is true. $\blacksquare$
